design: Post-hoc diagnostic, not held-out acceptance. Freeze one manually shortened lookup before running. Keep original question, source policy, source corpus and 800-token complete DTO. No model call and no production edits.
success: All requested facts supported by the returned verbatim spans; marker detection is diagnostic only. Controls must be manually reviewed for lost facts and unsupported premises.

hypotheses.hypothesis: The indexed scope table is retrieved but rejected by lexical body qualification; a shorter lookup may admit it without changing production.
The relevant budget paragraph is lost before projection because natural-language terms do not match its body sufficiently. Budget size is not the first blocker.
The answer reaches qualified variants but loses competition to usage prose. Forward continuation depends on which citation was selected and may read past or away from the missing fact.
The overflow paragraph reaches projection but cannot qualify for the question's wording; ranking alone cannot restore a rejected span.
Broad acceptance/testing lookups retrieve test instructions rather than the limit on product claims; the needed span is absent from the request's pre-cap pool.

controls.compact_lookup: guarantee every query complete correct answer

oracle_diagnostics: Known target first at projector ranking, keeping qualification unchanged: only for targets already present in the projector input.

Known target admitted past lexical qualification, preserving identity/freshness/risk/lifecycle/exact-anchor rejection; compare qualification alone with qualification plus target-first. Oracle labels use gold and are not deployable classifiers.
One manually selected contiguous authoritative answer span in an ordinary bounded DTO: feasibility upper bound, not a retrieval result.
For Q15 compare two actual forward reader attempts from each relevant returned locator; no whole-file read is sent to a model.
stopping_rule: No tuning compact lookups after seeing results. Report failures and oracle/practical differences; do not add a selector, synonyms or a second reader to production from five cases.
